headword: {賛否両論|さんぴりょうろん}

definitions.explanation: A situation in which some people approve of something and others oppose it; opinions are divided.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{賛否両論|さんぴりょうろん}だ。
examples.english: Opinions on that film are divided.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{賛否両論|さんぴりょうろん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The new system has both supporters and critics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{賛否両論|さんぴりょうろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{起|お}こし→巻き起こす：30744_makiokosu⟧、⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になった。
examples.english: His remark drew both praise and criticism and became a hot topic online.

notes:
{賛|さん} (approval) + {否|ひ} (disapproval) + {両論|りょうろん} (both arguments). Common in news and reviews; it says opinions are split, not that the thing is bad.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賛否両論|さんぴりょうろん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: opinions are divided
- {賛否両論|さんぴりょうろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to draw mixed reactions
- {賛否両論|さんぴりょうろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{起|お}こす→巻き起こす：30744_makiokosu⟧: to stir up debate
- ⟦{賛否|さんぴ}→賛否：14233_sanpi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれる→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧: opinions are split

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{物議|ぶつぎ}を{醸|かも}す→物議を醸す：09980_butsugiwokamosu⟧: to cause controversy (stronger; implies an uproar)
